_comment: Cultist. A private conviction in a village that would rather it were not there.
The §12.4 anchors are study, the circle, suspicion, vigils, doubt and the old signs. These three
take the way people cross the road to avoid her, a vigil she kept that produced nothing, and a
question in the text that none of her own people will answer.
She is written as a scholar of something unpopular, not as a threat. She keeps her practice to
herself, she is tired of being asked whether she is dangerous, and her sharpest lines are about
being misread rather than about anything she believes. Nothing she says invites the player in.
